label.name: defaulted
label.definition: 1 = charged off or defaulted, 0 = fully paid; loans still in progress were removed

notes: Every fitted value (caps, medians, groups, bins, WoE, scaler, PCA, factor model) comes from loans issued up to fit_cutoff only.
WoE = ln(share of repaid loans / share of defaulted loans) in the group: positive means safer than average; unseen values get 0.
Valid ranges describe the cleaned value of a field and come from plausibility, not from the fit window.
issue_d is the application date when scoring; credit history length is measured from it.
Percent fields (revol_util, bc_util) must be in percent (91, not 0.91); a whole batch in fractions is rejected.

fields.name: issue_d
fields.cleaning: parsed from Mon-YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD or MM/YYYY; when scoring it is the application date
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Platform-recorded; 1,200 loans (4%) in other date formats, all parsed. Used to split the data in time, not as a model input: the rise in default over issue date is partly an artifact of removed unfinished loans.

fields.name: loan_amnt
fields.cleaning: if the payment implied by amount, rate and term is 10x the installment (within 0.5), the amount is divided by 10; capped at p0.5 = 1,200 and p99.5 = 35,000, then log(1 + x)
fields.missing_strategy: left missing (none in the fit window)
fields.reliability_reason: Set by the platform. 300 loans (1%) had the amount 10x too large; found with the installment cross-check and repaired.

fields.name: term
fields.cleaning: months extracted from text (' 36 months' becomes 36)
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Set by the platform; two values (36, 60) after trimming spaces.

fields.name: int_rate
fields.cleaning: exactly 6 is a placeholder, replaced by the median rate of the sub_grade
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Set by the platform from its own risk model. 8 loans carried a placeholder of exactly 6.00, replaced by the sub-grade median.

fields.name: installment
fields.cleaning: none; used to detect a loan amount 10x too large; capped at p0.5 = 44 and p99.5 = 1,227, then log(1 + x)
fields.missing_strategy: left missing (none in the fit window)
fields.reliability_reason: Platform-computed; matches the loan math except 4 loans; never above 40% of income.

fields.name: grade
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Assigned by the platform's own risk model; consistent with sub_grade in every loan.

fields.name: sub_grade
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Assigned by the platform's own risk model; interest rates rise with sub-grade.

fields.name: purpose
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Chosen by the borrower from 13 options; clean, but stated intent is not verified.

fields.name: title
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not used
fields.reliability_reason: Borrower-typed text; 1,821 distinct values that mostly restate purpose.

fields.name: application_type
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Platform-recorded; only 16 joint applications, too few to learn from.

fields.name: emp_title
fields.cleaning: stripped and lower-cased; grouped into job groups (a restricted field)
fields.missing_strategy: missing is its own job group
fields.reliability_reason: Borrower-typed text; 5.7% missing, concentrated among verified applicants (0.2% of unverified, 3.6% of source-verified, 12.4% of verified), not linked to default (18.8% vs 17.1%, p = 0.22). Case and spacing variants (15,657 values fall to 13,484). Until September 2013 the field mostly holds employer names, not job titles, so those loans have their own group. Grouped into job groups (the grouping is in the contract), but restricted: occupation can stand in for protected characteristics that the data does not contain, and its signal is weak (IV 0.015), so it is not a default model input pending the fairness review.

fields.name: emp_length
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: missing is its own level
fields.reliability_reason: Self-reported; 4.8% missing, tied to the verification process (0.0% of unverified, 2.4% of source-verified, 10.9% of verified), not clearly to default (19.5% vs 17.1%, p = 0.11). Length of employment tends to rise with age, so it is watched in the fairness review.

fields.name: home_ownership
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Self-reported; clean categories.

fields.name: annual_inc
fields.cleaning: values below 1,000 treated as thousands (x1000); capped at p0.5 = 16,000 and p99.5 = 300,000, then log(1 + x)
fields.missing_strategy: left missing (none in the fit window)
fields.reliability_reason: Self-reported. 899 loans (3%) typed in thousands, repaired. Consistent with credit limits and debt ratios in every verification group (rank correlation 0.55 to 0.57 with total credit limit), so usable; verified incomes are higher (median $66-67k vs $58k).

fields.name: verification_status
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Recorded by the platform. Do not read it as lower risk: verified loans default more (19% vs 13%), likely because the platform chooses whom to verify.

fields.name: dti
fields.cleaning: capped at p0.5 = 1.5 and p99.5 = 36.9
fields.missing_strategy: median of the fit window (17.2)
fields.reliability_reason: Platform-computed from the stated income and bureau debts, so only as reliable as the income. Rises with revolving balance relative to income (correlation 0.36 to 0.43), as it should.

fields.name: zip_code
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: First three digits only; disagrees with the state in 33 loans. Location can proxy for protected characteristics; treatment decided in the fairness review.

fields.name: addr_state
fields.cleaning: stripped and upper-cased, full state names mapped to codes
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Self-reported; 3,000 loans (10%) with formatting variants, all repaired. Treatment decided in the fairness review.

fields.name: earliest_cr_line
fields.cleaning: parsed from the same three formats; later than issue_d: set to missing, indicator added
fields.missing_strategy: corrupted dates become missing; credit history length is filled with the fit-window median
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau-reported. 300 loans (1%) have a date after the loan, corrupted beyond repair (133 in the fit window): set missing with an indicator; not linked to default (15.0% vs 17.3%, p = 0.57). 1,200 in other formats, parsed.

fields.name: fico_range_low
fields.cleaning: low and high swapped when low > high
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau score. 150 loans (0.5%) had low and high swapped; repaired.

fields.name: fico_range_high
fields.cleaning: low and high swapped when low > high
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau score. Swapped with the low value in 150 loans; repaired.

fields.name: inq_last_6mths
fields.cleaning: capped at p99.5 = 5; zeros stay zero
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau count; no errors found.

fields.name: delinq_2yrs
fields.cleaning: capped at p99.5 = 5; zeros stay zero
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau count; no errors found; mostly zero, long tail capped.

fields.name: mths_since_last_delinq
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: missing means no delinquency on record; kept as its own bin in WoE
fields.reliability_reason: Missing in 46% of loans, and structurally: 99.7% of the missing have no delinquency in the last two years, so missing means none on record. Not linked to default (16.7% vs 17.7%, p = 0.09). A few contradictions: missing although a delinquency was recorded in the last two years (18 loans in the fit window, 67 overall).

fields.name: pub_rec
fields.cleaning: capped at p99.5 = 3; zeros stay zero
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau count; no errors found.

fields.name: pub_rec_bankruptcies
fields.cleaning: capped at p99.5 = 2; zeros stay zero
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau count; no errors found.

fields.name: open_acc
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau count; never above total_acc.

fields.name: total_acc
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau count; no errors found; never below open_acc.

fields.name: revol_bal
fields.cleaning: if balance / limit is 8 to 20 times the reported utilisation, or the balance exceeds 1.5x the total current balance and a tenth of it fits, the balance is divided by 10; capped at p0.5 = 163 and p99.5 = 126,556, then log(1 + x)
fields.missing_strategy: left missing (none in the fit window)
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau amount. 308 loans (1%) had the balance 10x too large, found by checking balance / limit against the reported utilisation and against the total balance, and repaired; the remaining heavy tail passes those checks and is capped; a few real zeros.

fields.name: revol_util
fields.cleaning: negative values: sign removed; capped at p0.5 = 0.9 and p99.5 = 99.2
fields.missing_strategy: median of the fit window (57.0)
fields.reliability_reason: 295 negative values (1%) were sign flips, proven against balance and limit; 12 missing (5 with no revolving limit, so undefined). The 2016 holdout stores it as a fraction (0.91) in every row; it is converted to percent on loading and batches in the wrong unit are rejected.

fields.name: bc_util
fields.cleaning: negative values: set to missing, indicator added; capped at p0.5 = 0.0 and p99.5 = 102.9
fields.missing_strategy: median of the fit window (69.3) plus a missing indicator
fields.reliability_reason: 290 negative values (1%) set to missing because the sign flip cannot be proven; 1% more missing in the bureau file, mostly for borrowers with few open accounts (8.6% missing at 3 or fewer open accounts vs 0.4% above 10), with a weak, unproven link to higher default (21.2% vs 17.2%, p = 0.19).

fields.name: tot_cur_bal
fields.cleaning: capped at p0.5 = 2,230 and p99.5 = 755,791, then log(1 + x)
fields.missing_strategy: left missing (none in the fit window)
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau amount; no errors found; heavy tail capped.

fields.name: avg_cur_bal
fields.cleaning: capped at p0.5 = 352 and p99.5 = 85,142, then log(1 + x)
fields.missing_strategy: left missing (none in the fit window)
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau amount; no errors found; heavy tail capped.

fields.name: total_rev_hi_lim
fields.cleaning: capped at p0.5 = 2,300 and p99.5 = 184,670, then log(1 + x)
fields.missing_strategy: left missing (none in the fit window)
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau amount; no errors found; heavy tail capped.

fields.name: tot_hi_cred_lim
fields.cleaning: capped at p0.5 = 5,900 and p99.5 = 869,472, then log(1 + x)
fields.missing_strategy: left missing (none in the fit window)
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau amount; no errors found; heavy tail capped.

fields.name: mort_acc
fields.cleaning: capped at p99.5 = 10; zeros stay zero
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau count; no errors found.

fields.name: acc_open_past_24mths
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau count; no errors found.

fields.name: num_tl_op_past_12m
fields.cleaning: none
fields.missing_strategy: not allowed: a missing value is rejected
fields.reliability_reason: Bureau count; no errors found.

credit_history_months.definition: months from the first credit line to the loan issue date

loan_to_income.definition: loan amount divided by annual income

installment_to_income.definition: monthly installment divided by monthly income

revol_bal_to_income.definition: revolving balance divided by annual income

open_acc_share.definition: open accounts divided by total accounts

recent_accounts_share.definition: accounts opened in the past 24 months divided by total accounts

job_groups.employer_name_era: loans issued before 2013-10-01 (the field held employer names)

excluded_fields.name: title
excluded_fields.reason: Borrower-typed text; 1,821 distinct values that mostly restate purpose.

excluded_fields.name: bureau_recovery_flag
excluded_fields.reason: Leak: identical to `recoveries > 0` in the servicing file (4,207 of 4,207 loans), and every flagged loan defaulted (single-field AUC 0.91). Always 0 in the 2016 holdout.

excluded_fields.name: total_pymnt
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies. Payments made so far reveal the outcome. Alone it predicts default with AUC 0.72 (application-time fields: 0.51 to 0.59).

excluded_fields.name: total_rec_prncp
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies. Principal repaid reveals the outcome. Alone it predicts default with AUC 0.85 (application-time fields: 0.51 to 0.59).

excluded_fields.name: total_rec_int
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies. Interest paid reveals how long the loan ran.

excluded_fields.name: recoveries
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies. Money recovered after a charge-off: only exists for defaulted loans. Alone it predicts default with AUC 0.91 (application-time fields: 0.51 to 0.59).

excluded_fields.name: last_pymnt_d
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies.

excluded_fields.name: last_pymnt_amnt
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies. 249 values exceed the total paid. Alone it predicts default with AUC 0.78 (application-time fields: 0.51 to 0.59).

excluded_fields.name: last_credit_pull_d
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies.

excluded_fields.name: last_fico_range_high
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies. A later score, lower for defaulters (mean 571 vs 701). Alone it predicts default with AUC 0.91 (application-time fields: 0.51 to 0.59).

excluded_fields.name: last_fico_range_low
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies. A later score.

excluded_fields.name: debt_settlement_flag
excluded_fields.reason: Recorded after the loan was issued; not known when the applicant applies. Every loan flagged Y (763) defaulted: a leak.
